protocol.decoder: Nested ridge; four contiguous held-out y bands, one adjacent sampled-lane guard on each side; three inner band folds without guards; training-only centering/scalar scaling/PCA
protocol.limitation: One fixed room/goal/heading and eastward samples. Position readout cannot distinguish a future-position code from current position plus a constant shift; it cannot isolate goal coding.
protocol.statistics: Paired t and exact two-sided sign-flip over 8 training seeds; Holm t-p correction separately within exploratory behavior and representation families; correlations descriptive, uncorrected.
